name: 大圖疊文字區＋方形小卡網格的一大四小拼貼
desc: 左側一張接近方形的大圖，左下方被一塊文字區蓋住；右側是每列兩張的方形小卡網格，和大圖等高，組成整齊的外框。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。內容對齊頁面內容寬度，左右兩欄寬度約各半，兩欄上下緣對齊、等高，組成整齊的外框；兩欄之間的間隔和網格卡片之間的間隔相同。左欄是一張接近方形的大圖片，圖片左下方被一塊文字區蓋住：文字區約佔圖片寬的七成、下方約四成高，底色和區塊背景相同，看起來像圖片左下角被切掉；文字區貼齊圖片的左緣與下緣，文字貼齊文字區的左緣、與圖片左緣對齊。文字區內由上而下是標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與靠右的按鈕，沒有時省略。右欄是多個方形卡片排成的網格，每列兩張，網格整體和左側大圖一樣高；每張卡片有自己的底，內容水平與垂直置中：上方一個小圖示，下方是標題，標題上方可放一段小標籤（可多行），沒有時省略。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：最上方是方形大圖，下方依序是小標籤、標題、說明文字與按鈕，文字不再壓在圖片上，取消重疊；按鈕橫跨整欄。最下方是方形卡片網格，仍維持每列兩張，卡片內容置中。

en.name: One-large-four-small collage: feature image with overlapping text panel + square tile grid
en.desc: On the left, a nearly square large image with a text panel covering its bottom-left; on the right, a grid of square tiles two per row, as tall as the image, forming a neat outer frame.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The content is aligned to the page content width and split into two columns of roughly equal width; the top and bottom edges of the two columns line up and they are equal in height, forming a neat outer frame; the gap between the two columns is the same as the gap between the grid cards. The left column is a large, nearly square image whose bottom-left is covered by a text panel: the panel takes about seventy percent of the image width and about the lower forty percent of its height, and its background matches the section background, so it looks as if the bottom-left corner of the image has been cut away. The text panel is flush with the left and bottom edges of the image, and its text is flush with the left edge of the panel, lining up with the left edge of the image. Inside the text panel, from top to bottom, is a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description and a right-aligned button below; omit them when there is no content. The right column is a grid of multiple square cards, two per row, and the grid as a whole is as tall as the large image on the left. Each card has its own background, with its content centered horizontally and vertically: a small icon on top and a title below it, optionally with a short label (may wrap to multiple lines) above the title; omit it when there is no content.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The layout stacks vertically: the square large image at the top, followed by the label, title, description and button, with the text no longer overlapping the image (the overlap is removed); the button spans the full column width. At the bottom is the square card grid, still two cards per row, with each card's content centered.
